chansons.style: Heavy metal, fast palm muted riffs, aggressive double kick drums, powerful soaring vocals, upbeat summer vibes, 150 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: Un hymne metal explosif qui célèbre l'énergie sauvage et la chaleur de l'été sur la plage.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
[Verse 1]
The ocean is boiling, the sand is on fire
We’re cranking the volume, taking it higher
No suits and no ties, just leather and sweat
The heaviest summer that you’ll ever get
[Pre-Chorus]
Waves crashing loud like a double kick drum
Here in the heat is where we are from
[Chorus]
Sunburnt steel, burning the shore
Metal and sand, we are screaming for more
Sunburnt steel, melting the tide
Ride the wild ocean, let the heavy rock ride
[Verse 2]
The palm trees are shaking, the amps are all red
We’re drinking the salt, ignoring the dread
A board on the water, a riff in the sky
We’re surfing the distortion until the day dies
[Pre-Chorus]
Waves crashing loud like a double kick drum
Here in the heat is where we are from
[Chorus]
Sunburnt steel, burning the shore
Metal and sand, we are screaming for more
Sunburnt steel, melting the tide
Ride the wild ocean, let the heavy rock ride
[Bridge]
Salt in the wounds, rust on the strings
The heat of the sun is the king of all things
[Chorus]
Sunburnt steel, burning the shore
Metal and sand, we are screaming for more
Sunburnt steel, melting the tide
Ride the wild ocean, let the heavy rock ride
[Outro]
Let it ride!
Sunburnt steel!
Fade to the waves.

Never stop!
Asphalt veins!
